verdict.rationale: A state business registry could plausibly publish bulk registry extracts, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents bulk downloads, datasets, or registry extracts. The cited surfaces cover Gateway login, filing tips, the tax forms library, and a tax-rate lookup tool, which are interactive or document-search features rather than bulk data. The robots.txt probes show only access walls on ohiosos.gov and bsportal.ohiosos.gov, with no data-download offering.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
